arxiv-1511-01665.title: An Empirical Study on Sentiment Classification of Chinese Review using Word Embedding
arxiv-1511-01665.creator: Yiou Lin, Hang Lei, Jia Wu, Xiaoyu Li
arxiv-1511-01665.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Yiou Lin, Hang Lei, Jia Wu, Xiaoyu Li. In this article, how word embeddings can be used as features in Chinese sentiment classification is presented. Firstly, a Chinese opinion corpus is built with a million comments from hotel review websites. Then the word embeddings which represent each comment are used as input in different machine learning methods for sentiment classification, including SVM, Logistic Regression, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and ensemble methods.

arxiv-1904-06998.title: An optimal polynomial approximation of Brownian motion
arxiv-1904-06998.creator: James Foster, Terry Lyons, Harald Oberhauser
arxiv-1904-06998.description: Abstract In this paper, we will present a strong (or pathwise) approximation of standard Brownian motion by a class of orthogonal polynomials. The coefficients that are obtained from the expansion of Brownian motion in this polynomial basis are independent Gaussian random variables.

arxiv-1911-11541.title: Does ICSE Accept the Right Contributions?
arxiv-1911-11541.creator: Lutz Prechelt
arxiv-1911-11541.description: Abstract Background: There is a constant discussion regarding whether the ICSE Technical Research track is accepting too many contributions of some type and too few of some other type. Questions: Are ICSE and the contributions it is seeing well aligned with what is important for bringing software engineering forward?

arxiv-2008-11020.title: Frierson’s 1907 Parameterization of Compound Magic Squares Extended to Orders 3 l 3^{l} , l = 1 , 2 , 3 , . . l=1,2,3,.. , with Information Entropy
arxiv-2008-11020.creator: P.D.Loly, I.D.Cameron
arxiv-2008-11020.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by P.D.Loly, I.D.Cameron. Frierson used a powerful parameterization of the pattern of the order 3 3 associative magic square to construct a family of six related order 3 2 = 9 3^{2}=9 compound (or composite) magic squares, several of them ancient. Stimulated by Bellew’s 1997 extension to order 27 = 3 3 27=3^{3} , we extend these ideas to all orders 3 l 3^{l} , l = 1 , 2 , 3 , .

arxiv-2107-03843.title: Spacetime Hall-MHD turbulence at sub-ion scales: structures or waves? Journal: Astrophysical Journal Letters
arxiv-2107-03843.creator: Emanuele Papini, Antonio Cicone, Luca Franci, Mirko Piersanti, Simone Landi, Petr Hellinger, Andrea Verdini
arxiv-2107-03843.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Emanuele Papini, Antonio Cicone, Luca Franci, Mirko Piersanti, Simone Landi, Petr Hellinger, Andrea Verdini. Spatiotemporal properties of two-dimensional (2D) Hall-magnetohydrodynamic turbulence at intermediate plasma β = 2 \beta=2 are studied by means of Fast Iterative Filtering, a new technique for the decomposition of nonstationary nonlinear signals. Results show that the magnetic energy at sub-ion scales is concentrated in perturbations with frequencies smaller than the ion-cyclotron (IC) frequency and with polarization properties that are incompatible with both kinetic Alfvén waves (KAWs) and IC waves.

arxiv-2210-09954.title: Decomposition and conformal mapping techniques for the quadrature of nearly singular integrals
arxiv-2210-09954.creator: William Mitchell and Abbie Natkin and Paige Robertson and Marika Sullivan and Xuechen Yu and Chenxin Zhu
arxiv-2210-09954.description: Abstract . Gauss-Legendre quadrature and the trapezoidal rule are powerful tools for numerical integration of analytic functions. For nearly singular problems, however, these standard methods become unacceptably slow. We discuss and generalize some existing methods for improving on these schemes when the location of the nearby singularity is known.

arxiv-2304-08285.title: DIALITE: Discover, Align and Integrate Open Data Tables Conference: Companion of the 2023 International Conference on Management of Data; June 18–23, 2023; Seattle, WA, USA Companion of the 2023 International Conference on Management of Data (SIGMOD-Companion ’23), June 18–23, 2023, Seattle, WA, USA
arxiv-2304-08285.creator: Aamod Khatiwada, Roee Shraga, Renée J. Miller
arxiv-2304-08285.description: Abstract . We demonstrate a novel table discovery pipeline called DIALITE that allows users to discover, integrate and analyze open data tables. DIALITE has three main stages. First, it allows users to discover tables from open data platforms using state-of-the-art table discovery techniques. Second, DIALITE integrates the discovered tables to produce an integrated table.

arxiv-2311-17157.title: Dark matter relic density in strongly interacting dark sectors with light vector mesons Preprint: FERMILAB-PUB-23-744-T, TTP23-057, P3H-23-096
arxiv-2311-17157.creator: Elias Bernreuther, Nicoline Hemme, Felix Kahlhoefer, Suchita Kulkarni
arxiv-2311-17157.description: Abstract Stable dark matter particles may arise as pseudo-Goldstone bosons from the confinement of dark quarks interacting via a non-Abelian gauge force. Their relic abundance is determined not by annihilations into visible particles but by dark pion number-changing processes within the dark sector, such as 3 ​ π D → 2 ​ π D 3{\pi_{D}}\to 2{\pi_{D}} .

arxiv-2412-17117.title: Traveling-wave solutions and structure-preserving numerical methods for a hyperbolic approximation of the Korteweg-de Vries equation
arxiv-2412-17117.creator: Abhijit Biswas, David I. Ketcheson, Hendrik Ranocha, Jochen Schütz
arxiv-2412-17117.description: Abstract We study the recently-proposed hyperbolic approximation of the Korteweg-de Vries equation (KdV). We show that this approximation, which we call KdVH, possesses a rich variety of solutions, including solitary wave solutions that approximate KdV solitons, as well as other solitary and periodic solutions that are related to higher-order water wave models, and may include singularities.

arxiv-2505-12335.title: Is Artificial Intelligence Generated Image Detection a Solved Problem?
arxiv-2505-12335.creator: Ziqiang Li Jiazhen Yan Ziwen He Kai Zeng, Weiwei Jiang Lizhi Xiong Zhangjie Fu
arxiv-2505-12335.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of generative models, such as GANs and Diffusion models, has enabled the creation of highly realistic synthetic images, raising serious concerns about misinformation, deepfakes, and copyright infringement. Although numerous Artificial Intelligence Generated Image (AIGI) detectors have been proposed, often reporting high accuracy, their effectiveness in real-world scenarios remains questionable.

arxiv-2510-16449.title: TrajSelector : Harnessing Latent Representations for Efficient and Effective Best-of- N N in Large Reasoning Model
arxiv-2510-16449.creator: Bin Yu, Xinming Wang, Shijie Lian, Haotian Li, Changti Wu, Ruina Hu, Bailing Wang, Yuliang Wei, Kai Chen
arxiv-2510-16449.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in complex reasoning tasks, largely enabled by test-time scaling (TTS) paradigms that allocate additional compute during inference. Among these, external TTS—particularly the Best-of- N N selection paradigm—yields scalable performance improvements by selecting from multiple independently generated reasoning trajectories.

arxiv-2602-10522.title: Consistency Meets Verification: Enhancing Test Generation Quality in Large Language Models Without Ground-Truth Solutions
arxiv-2602-10522.creator: 1 st Hamed Taherkhani, 2 nd Alireza DaghighFarsoodeh, 3 rd Mohammad Chowdhury, 4 th Hung Viet Pham, 5 th Hadi Hemmati
arxiv-2602-10522.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated test generation, yet existing methods often rely on ground-truth code for verification, risking bug propagation and limiting applicability in test-driven development. We present ConVerTest, a novel two-stage pipeline for synthesizing reliable tests without requiring prior code implementations.

pmc-10666136.title: Experimental Investigation on Layer Subdivision Water Injection in Multilayer Heterogeneous Reservoirs
pmc-10666136.creator: Lifei Dong, Pinzhi Zhong, Qi Zhang, Miao Wang, Wenzhuo Dong, Youqi Wang, Chao Yang
pmc-10666136.description: Layer subdivision is currently one of the principal techniques employed to solve interlayer contradictions during water injection in multilayer heterogeneous reservoirs, but experimental research on the mechanism and the corresponding implementation plans is lacking. In this study, a multilayer heterogeneous core model was designed, and physical simulation experiments with different subdivisions and variation coefficients were conducted.

pmc-12650221.title: Modified Pentylenetetrazole Model for Acute Seizure Induction in Rats
pmc-12650221.creator: Aseel Saadi, Sereen Sandouka, Rhoda Olowe Taiwo, Yara Sheeni, Tawfeeq Shekh-Ahmad, Natalia V Gulyaeva, Sreeja Sarasamma
pmc-12650221.description: Background/Objectives: Acute seizure models are widely used in epilepsy research to investigate seizure mechanisms and evaluate antiseizure drug efficacy. Among these models, pentylenetetrazole (PTZ)-induced seizures provide a controlled and reproducible approach to study acute seizure dynamics. However, existing PTZ protocols often suffer from inconsistent seizure induction, high mortality rates, and limited translational relevance.

pmc-12709822.title: Association between stress hyperglycemia ratio and all-cause mortality in patients with coronary heart disease
pmc-12709822.creator: Hailin Liang, Chujuan Zeng, Junhong Huang, Yongluan Lin, Songming Chen
pmc-12709822.description: BackgroundStress hyperglycemia ratio (SHR) has been associated with adverse clinical outcomes in hospitalized patients with acute coronary syndromes (ACS). However, its role in long-term prognosis remains controversial. This study aims to investigate the correlation between SHR and post-discharge all-cause mortality in coronary heart disease (CHD) patients.

pmc-12978064.title: Elemental Analysis of Maha Kumbh‐2025 Water Along With Intercomparison With Other Water Resources Using Synchrotron‐Assisted Total‐Reflection X‐Ray Fluorescence Analysis: A Case Study
pmc-12978064.creator: M K Tiwari, Ajay Khooha, Ayushi Trivedi, G G Potey, V K Mahadik, Ajit Kumar Singh
pmc-12978064.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Total reflection X‐ray fluorescence (TXRF) is a well‐established method to detect ultra‐trace elements present in water as well as in other liquids that can be diluted into the water medium. In the present case study, we have applied the TXRF technique to analyze various elements present in the Maha Kumbh‐2025 water sample, which was collected from the nose point of Triveni Sangam, at Prayagraj, India.

pmc-13314692.title: Low prevalence targets are primarily missed due to mind wandering
pmc-13314692.creator: Haden Dewis, Michael C. Hout, Joseph W. Houpt, Lois Howsley, Hayward J. Godwin
pmc-13314692.description: The impact of target prevalence (the proportion of trials in which a target appears) has been widely studied within visual search. The low prevalence effect is the finding that rare targets are often missed. Mind wandering, where one’s attention drifts away from a primary goal, impairs performance across various tasks, but its influence in low-prevalence search remains unclear.

pmc-13572333.title: Efficacy of low-level laser therapy for subacromial impingement syndrome: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13572333.creator: Liangsheng Chen, Yage Wang
pmc-13572333.description: To systematically explore the therapeutic effects of low-level laser therapy (LLLT) on pain, shoulder range of motion (ROM), and functional disability in patients with subacromial impingement syndrome (SIS). Eight databases were systematically searched. We assessed study quality with the Cochrane Risk of Bias tool, and evidence quality was evaluated using the GRADE approach.
